headline: Littler beats Humphries to win the Czech Darts Open in Prague
standfirst: Luke Littler won European Tour 12, beating Luke Humphries 8-6 in the final after a 106.64 average against Michael van Gerwen in the semis.
body: Luke Littler won the Czech Darts Open at the PVA Expo in Prague, beating Luke Humphries 8-6 in the final. The final was a lower-scoring affair than their earlier rounds, with Littler averaging 95.25 to Humphries' 94.81.

Littler's best darts came earlier. He averaged 108.59 to beat Niko Springer in the last 32 and then beat Krzysztof Ratajski 6-3. He whitewashed Danny Noppert 6-0 in the quarter-finals and averaged 106.64 in a 7-3 semi-final win over Michael van Gerwen, including a 167 checkout.

Humphries averaged 108.98 against Beau Greaves in the last 32, the best average of the event. He beat William O'Connor 6-3 and then Gerwyn Price 7-4 in the semi-finals, despite Price averaging 102.16.
Martin Schindler's 170 checkout against Wessel Nijman was the highest finish of the weekend.
Humphries hit 19 maximums and Littler 18, with Price on 11.
